title: Netting the Added Invoice's Down Payment Against the Amount Spread
content:
Plan ledger conventions — **Patient Payment Plans**: how much of the down payment taken on an invoice being added to a plan comes off the amount spread when the plan's installment is set anew.

## Convention

How much of the down payment taken on the invoice being added comes off the amount spread depends on the payment setup: on a plan drawn automatically from a bank account and accepted at least 6 whole months before today, all of it; on a plan drawn automatically from a credit or debit card, one half of it; on any other plan, none of it.

The part that comes off is taken from the balance due of the invoice being added, and the remainder is taken to the nearest cent, an exact half cent being rounded up.

## Reading the ledger

- **Down payment taken on the invoice being added** — the down payments posted on the plan ledger, added together, less the down payment fixed when the plan was accepted.
- **Drawn automatically from a bank account** — automatic payments set up with bank transfer (ACH) as the method on file; **from a credit or debit card** — automatic payments set up with a card as the method on file.
- **Accepted at least 6 whole months before today** — counted in whole months from the plan's acceptance date to today.

## Share netted (a multiplier of 1, 0.5 or 0)

| Automatic payments | Method on file | Accepted at least 6 whole months ago | Share of that down payment taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Bank transfer | Yes | All (1) |
| Yes | Bank transfer | No | None (0) |
| Yes | Credit or debit card | Yes or No | One half (0.5) |
| No | — | Yes or No | None (0) |

## Hypothetical ledger

Down payments on the ledger total 186.40; the down payment fixed at acceptance was 150.00, so 36.40 was taken on the invoice being added, whose balance due is 362.50.

- Bank-transfer draws, accepted 9 whole months ago: 362.50 less 36.40, that is 326.10, is spread.
- Credit-card draws, accepted 2 whole months ago: one half of 36.40 is 18.20, and 362.50 less 18.20, that is 344.30, is spread.
- Bank-transfer draws, accepted 4 whole months ago: none comes off; 362.50 is spread.
- Paid manually: none comes off; 362.50 is spread.
